name: sketch-proxy
description: Draw on your running web app (mouse, iPad + Apple Pencil) and let the agent make the change

interface.shortDescription: Draw on your running app, the agent makes the change
interface.longDescription: Proxies your local dev server and adds a drawing layer to every page. Circle, cross out, draw arrows and add a note from a browser or an iPad with Apple Pencil; Codex gets an annotated screenshot plus the DOM elements under each mark, makes the change and reports back on the page.
defaultPrompt: Start a sketch session on my dev server, I'll draw on it.
Open the app on my iPad over Tailscale, I'll sketch.
